text: Hi, sorry I'm a childminder and I've got an 8 month old boy staying over with me tonight while his parents are at a family thing out of town, I've rung them but no answer which is fair enough its the middle of the night. His temprature is 39.4, I've checked it twice with the ear thermomter to be sure. He's also got a sticky eye, the white bit is pink and theres yellowy gunk in the corner, I think it might be conjunctivitus? not sure. I've wiped it with cooled boiled water and cotton wool like I'd do for any of the little ones. I've got his parents written permission for calpol and the dose on the bottle but I wanted to check with someone before I give anything because I'm not his mum and I don't want to get it wrong. I've been doing this nine years and I'm usually fine but I've had three in today plus him overnight and honestly I'm so tired I'm second guessing myself. Is the eye something that needs seeing tonight or can it wait til his parents are back tomorrow
